item.description: A months-long narcotics investigation into a major drug trafficking organization culminated on Wednesday when Richmond County deputies executed two coordinated search warrants and seized more than 30 pounds of illegal drugs, firearms, vehicles, and cash. item.title: Lawmakers seek Lottery money for need-based college scholarships
item.description: A record number enrolled in Georgia’s public colleges and universities this fall as the state’s lottery continued to produce a windfall for academic scholarships, but a bipartisan legislative committee thinks too many students are still being left behind.
